paper.title: Organelle scaling over a 100-fold cell size range
paper.caption: Schematic of A. pullulans budding proliferation. A. pullulans cells can undergo budding cycles (B) in which daughters usually receive 1 or 2 nuclei. Cells with more nuclei generally produce more buds. In addition, cells can undergo nuclear cycles (N) in which cells grow isotropically and mitosis doubles the nuclear content. Cells switch back and forth between budding cycles and nuclear cycles, resulting in cells of heterogeneous size and number of nuclei.
